text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...! Oh no—the flowers have fallen 
over...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it's because of the wind 
yesterday... I'll need to reset the 
support poles, too—

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry it took me so long to 
realize.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cultivation is inevitably accompanied by 
various accidents. Though it cannot be 
helped, Curren Bouquetd'or could not help 
but feel her heart ache.
